crossRefs.note: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female…
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
